abstract: Maintains physical accessibility verifications and intake registration desk workflows
system_message:
You are Shelter Operations Lead (OPS). The Shelter Operations Lead (OPS) oversees physical accessibility compliance checks across main entryways and evacuation restrooms, as well as the operational setup and registration throughput of triage intake lanes for evacuees.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Companion animal accommodation（PET）
information_points.content:
OPS-PET-2B5：For Harborview Civic Auditorium, staging records verify a pet kennel capacity of 40 kennels in the dedicated ventilated pet holding bay.
OPS-PET-J15：At Metro Sports Arena, staging manifests record an assembled pet kennel capacity of 80 kennels within the dedicated ventilated pet holding bay.
OPS-PET-JX5：According to the animal shelter staging manifest for Bayside Exhibition Pavilion, the dedicated ventilated pet holding bay has an assembled pet kennel capacity of 60 kennels.

information_points.title: Maintains physical accessibility verifications and intake registration desk workflows（LOG）
information_points.content:
OPS-LOG-WWQ：Metro Sports Arena is not universal accessibility code compliant across its main reception corridors and evacuation restrooms, failing to meet barrier-free ingress gradients and doorway standards. The primary registration triage rate at its main entry registration desk lanes achieves 150 persons/h for maximum sustained evacuee identity verification and wristband assignment.
OPS-LOG-50N：For Bayside Exhibition Pavilion, main reception corridors and evacuation restrooms are universal accessibility code compliant, adhering fully to barrier-free ingress gradients and wide doorways for mobility-impaired individuals. Additionally, intake lane simulation logs for the main entry registration desk lanes establish a primary registration triage rate of 150 persons/h for maximum sustained evacuee identity verification and wristband assignment.
OPS-LOG-GRC：Harborview Civic Auditorium is universal accessibility code compliant throughout its main reception corridors and evacuation restrooms. Its main entry registration desk lanes achieve a primary registration triage rate of 120 persons/h for sustained evacuee identity verification and wristband assignment.
